rows.notes: Released mission title reused verbatim from missions_019.json.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Everyone's here. By intercepting <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> comms, we have a lead on <color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s whereabouts.
rows.notes: Speaker 30060 = Jamil Neate. Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>He's currently<thumbnail(256)> under the protection of a <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>-hired <book(39)>Vulture<endbook()> ship. A warship called the <color(6)>Swan<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'Vulture' per character_names_021/glossary lock. 'Swan' for the ship name (Eureka Seven wiki page title, Charles/Ray Beams's SL-1200 MkI) follows the precedent already used and proposed in reviewed scene 4004633.json; not yet promoted to terms_028.json/glossary.json. Phrasing reordered so New Federation precedes Vulture, matching the source's tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Right now that ship is anchored off the island with a <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> research facility - <book(45)>Zonder Epta<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Zonder Epta per meeting_terms_015.json lock. Reordered so New Federation precedes Zonder Epta, matching source tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><book(39)>Vulture<endbook()> or not, their employer is the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>. It would be bad if <color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s identity got out.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>We need to go rescue him as soon as possible... but one bad thing has happened.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>A moment ago, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()><thumbnail(257)>, having heard about this, took off alone on a ref board to go after <color(4)>Renton<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'ref board' for rifubo-do per encyclopedia_021_b.json LFO entry lock.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Where she headed is, of course, <book(45)>Zonder Epta<endbook()> Island.

<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>At this rate, not only <color(4)>Renton<ce()> but <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> too will be caught by the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>. We have to get to them before that happens.
rows.notes: 'Not only' used instead of 'not just' to avoid the lowercase j.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>So, we're now carrying out a rescue operation for <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The <color(4)>Gekko<ce()><thumbnail(176)> is already back too. We're heading out right away.
rows.notes: 'Gekko' for the ship name (Gekkou-gou) per meeting_terms_015.json lock.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Getting <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> out fast is top priority. The enemy's already noticed us. Risky, but this will be a head-on fight.
<thumbdown()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Sorry to drag you into our mess. But <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> is someone we can't do without.

rows.notes: 'her' sourced (Eureka, addressed a few lines earlier).

rows.en: <operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>But it's no good without <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> and <color(4)>Renton<ce()>. Make sure you bring the two of them back.
